fitr 0.11.7 - evidence for what local AI
  works on this machine

usage:
  fitr
    installed models, evidence, next
      command
  fitr <model>
    named advise (same as fitr advise
      <model>)
  fitr run <model>
    measure one exact configuration
  fitr board
    compare saved results on this
      machine
  fitr role
    what a model is for, and whether
      evidence holds

measure:
  fitr advise [model] [--vram-gb N]
    [--ctx N] [--load] [--fit]
  fitr run <model>
    [--quick|--full|--checks-only] [-k
    N] [--ctx N] [--profile P]
    [--display MODE] [--html]
  fitr run <model> --context-tiers
    <bytes,bytes[,...]> [--ctx N]
  fitr diag <model>
  fitr doctor <model> [-n N]
  fitr suggest [model] [--size-gb N]
    [--ceiling-gb N]
  fitr top [--view
    live|result|board|history|inventory]
  fitr top view [model|result.json]
  fitr top run <model> [run flags]
  fitr top history [path|clear --yes]

compare:
  fitr compare <model-a> <model-b>
  fitr tune [model-a model-b]
  fitr calibrate <model-a> <model-b>
    [--out PATH] [--lineage PATH]
  fitr calibrate merge <pair.json>...
    [--out PATH]
  fitr decide [model|result.json] --spec
    decision.json [--display MODE]
  fitr experiment context <model> --ctx
    4096,8192,... [-k N]
  fitr experiment quant <result.json>
    <result.json>... --spec
    decision.json [--lineage
    conversion.json]
  fitr experiment confirm <model-a>
    <model-b> --spec decision.json
    [--ctx N] [-k N] [--min-gap F]
    [--noise-from result.json]
  fitr experiment workload <model> [-n
    N] [--ctx N] [--workflow
    pi-workspace] [--backend B]
  fitr experiment serving <model>
    [--concurrency N] [-n N] [--warmup
    N] [--ctx N] [--backend B]
  fitr experiment reference plan|run
    seals a recorded external pack; it
    does not launch one
  fitr view [model|result.json]
    [--display MODE]
  fitr export <model> [--out PATH]
    [--retonr]
  fitr apply [model] [--ctx N]

roles and tailoring:
  fitr role init <name> --quality <need>
    --memory-gb <limit> [--ctx N]
  fitr role define <role.json> | list |
    show <name> | review <name>
  fitr role attach <name> <result.json>
    | detach <name> <evidence-sha256>
  fitr role confirm <name|bundle.json> |
    adopt <name> <bundle.json> | status
    <name> | rollback <name>
  fitr auto runtime <ollama.exe>
    --models <directory> --out
    runtime.json
  fitr auto start <role> --mode
    establish|improve --runtime
    runtime.json --candidate <model>
    --candidate <model>
  fitr auto status|resume|adopt
    <session-id>
  fitr tailor plan --role <name>
    --outcome <need> --candidate <model>
    --ctx N (--capacity-budget-gb N |
    --capacity-reserve-gb N --memory-gb
    N)
  fitr tailor start|status|resume|adopt
    <session-id>
  fitr discover add <source> --role
    <role> [--model <reference>]
    [--harness <name>]
  fitr discover list|plan [--role
    <role>] [--display MODE]

desktop and integrations:
  fitr desktop status [--role NAME]
    [--display MODE]
  fitr desktop benchmark [--role NAME]
    [--confirm] [--display MODE]
  fitr desktop install [--plugins-dir
    DIR]
  fitr desktop remove [--plugins-dir
    DIR] --yes
  fitr mcp serve
  fitr source resolve hf --repo
    <owner/model> --revision <revision>
    --file <path> --out <receipt.json>
  fitr source show <receipt.json>
    [--display MODE]

maintenance:
  fitr device
  fitr profiles [new [name]]
  fitr update [--check] [--reinstall]
  fitr artifact bind --source
    <resolution.json> --mapping
    <local-files.json> --out
    <artifact.json>
  fitr artifact show <artifact.json>
    [--display MODE]
  fitr cleanup plan <directory>
    [--min-age-days N] [--display MODE]

flags:
  --display auto|rich|plain|json|none
    output mode (default auto)
  -k
    repeats per noisy task (default 3; 1
      quick; 5 checks-only)

fitr help <command> prints that
  command's flags.
fitr help experiment context prints one
  experiment form.

environment:
  FITR_OPENAI_URL
    OpenAI-compatible endpoint
  FITR_OPENAI_API_KEY
    bearer token; kept out of command
      history and process arguments
  FITR_OPENAI_MODEL_SHA256
    independently obtained model digest
      required for measured
      OpenAI-compatible runs

exit codes:
  0 eligible/ok 1 error 2 usage 3
    disproven 4 unresolved 130
    interrupted
